source.title: The efficacy of dapagliflozin combined with hypoglycaemic drugs in treating type 2 diabetes mellitus: meta-analysis of randomised controlled trials

secondary_source_guardrail: Sun et al. is a systematic review/meta-analysis. Pooled review-level estimates are tagged secondary_source; individual trial rows are not represented as if Sun et al. enrolled those participants.
source_integrity_findings: The abstract reverses the ordering of the two sensitivity-analysis result sets relative to the Results section.
GRADE Table 2 lists HbA1c as 3,986 participants from 14 studies, while the Results text says 12 randomized trials.
GRADE Table 2 lists body weight as 4,008 participants from 14 studies, while the Results text says 12 randomized trials.

Table 3 prints an FPG week coefficient of -0.01 with a 95% CI of 0.004 to 0.012, which is incompatible in sign with the point estimate; Results prose describes -1.52 as the follow-up-duration coefficient while Table 3 presents -1.52 as the intercept.
The body-weight meta-regression is described as significant with R-squared 1 and p<0.01, while Table 3 prints a week estimate of -0.01 with 95% CI -0.02 to 0.01, which crosses zero.
